topic.readerProblem: Buyers choosing between AEOeye's one-off audit and LLMrefs' subscription keyword tracker need to know which fits their job, what each costs and where each is weaker.
topic.connection: AEOeye sells a free ChatGPT check and a $29 one-time five-engine report; the page routes readers who need weekly monitoring to LLMrefs and everyone else to a baseline audit first.

assessment: The page replaces an older comparison that called the free audit multi-engine and leaned on a third-party review's scores. It now states LLMrefs' published facts (price, prompts, engines, refresh, exports, unpublished free-plan limits) from LLMrefs' own pages, the correct AEOeye product facts, and a cost-over-a-year calculation. It does not claim hands-on use of LLMrefs, rate data accuracy, or assert unverified free-plan limits or daily refresh.

sources.supports: Tracks keywords not prompts; 11 listed engines; $79/month All in One plan with 500 prompts, 7-day trial, 'Limited time only'; at-least-weekly keyword refresh; dashboard data within 5 minutes; FAQ on upgrading beyond 50 keywords; CSV export and API access; unlimited projects/seats; geo coverage statements (20+ countries/10+ languages vs 50+ countries/20+ languages).
Pricing card: $79/month, 7-day free trial, 500 prompts, weekly reports, 50+ countries & 20+ languages, unlimited team members and projects, CSV and API; no free-plan limits listed.
Getting Started documentation page reads 'Coming soon'.
Disallows only /account, /dashboard and /api; no AI bots blocked.
Starter $95/month monthly billing with 50 prompts (rendered in a browser; prices are JavaScript-rendered).
Google describes AI Mode's 'query fan-out' technique of issuing multiple related searches across subtopics and combining the results.
Definition of GEO, also called AEO.
